name: City bus
headline: length
subtitle: New Flyer Xcelsior 40-foot transit bus
description: New Flyer's Xcelsior low-floor transit bus is built in 35, 40 and 60 ft sizes, and the 40-foot version measures 41 ft 0 in (12.50 m) over the bumpers and 102 in (2.6 m) wide, with a roof height of 10 ft 6 in to 11 ft 1 in depending on the powertrain. It seats up to 40 passengers with room for up to 44 more standing.

measures.label: Length over bumpers
measures.note: 40-foot Xcelsior, 41 ft 0 in over bumpers; 40 ft 2 in (12.24 m) over the body

measures.label: Roof height
measures.note: 10 ft 6 in over the A/C (diesel) to 11 ft 1 in over roof enclosures or charging rails (CNG, electric)

measures.label: Curb weight
measures.note: Approximate empty weight of the 40-foot bus, from diesel (27,750 lb) to battery-electric (33,805 lb); varies with options

facts.text: The 40-foot Xcelsior seats up to 40 passengers and carries up to 44 standees.
The bus comes in diesel, hybrid, CNG and battery-electric versions; the curb weight of the 40-foot model ranges from about 27,750 lb (diesel) to 33,805 lb (electric).
The wheelbase is 283.75 in (7.2 m), and interior height is 95 in (2.4 m) mid-coach.
New Flyer says it has delivered over 6,400 clean diesel buses in North America since 2010.

caveats: A '40-foot' bus is a nominal size class; the example here is 41 ft 0 in over bumpers and 40 ft 2 in over the body. Other makers' 40-foot buses differ slightly.
Weights are New Flyer's approximate curb weights and vary with customer options.
